settings.title: OTP settings
settings.description: Choose where customers must confirm themselves with a one-time password.

login_with_otp.title: Login with OTP
login_with_otp.description: Customers can sign in with a one-time password sent to their phone number or e-mail.

guest_checkout_with_otp.title: Guest checkout with OTP
guest_checkout_with_otp.description: Guests verify their phone with an OTP before an order is placed.

cod_wallet_otp.title: OTP for cash on delivery and wallet payments
cod_wallet_otp.description: Require an OTP before a cash-on-delivery or wallet payment is confirmed, to stop fraudulent orders.

gateways.title: SMS gateways
gateways.description: Credentials of the SMS providers. Only one provider can be active; it sends every OTP and SMS.
gateways.saveFirst: Save the required credentials before activating.

hints.whatsapp: WhatsApp service only. Unique ID of the linked WhatsApp account.
hints.device: SMS service only. Unique ID of your linked device; fill it only when sending from one of your own devices.
hints.gateway: SMS service only. Unique ID of a partner device or third-party gateway; fill it only when sending through one.
hints.sim: SMS service only. SIM slot used for sending; ignored for partner devices and third-party gateways.

templates.title: SMS templates
templates.description: Text of the SMS messages sent for verification, orders and deliveries. Keep the [[variables]] as they are.
